gloss: prominent, leading, one of the best

definitions.gloss: prominent, leading, one of the best, top-ranking
definitions.explanation: Being counted among the very best or most notable in a given category. Implies that something or someone ranks highly among peers.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}{有数|ゆうすう}の{大企業|だいきぎょう}だ。
examples.english: It is one of the world's leading corporations.

examples.japanese: ここは{日本|にほん}{有数|ゆうすう}の{温泉地|おんせんち}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: This place is known as one of Japan's top hot spring areas.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{国内|こくない}{有数|ゆうすう}の{米|こめ}の{産地|さんち}で、{毎年|まいとし}{高品質|こうひんしつ}な{米|こめ}を{生産|せいさん}している。
examples.english: This region is one of the country's leading rice-producing areas, producing high-quality rice every year.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used in the pattern 「Scope + {有数|ゆうすう}の + Noun」: {世界|せかい}{有数|ゆうすう}の (one of the world's top), {日本|にほん}{有数|ゆうすう}の (one of Japan's leading), {国内|こくない}{有数|ゆうすう}の (one of the nation's top). Literally means "countable among" — i.e., so prominent that it can be counted among the best.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世界|せかい}{有数|ゆうすう}の: one of the world's leading
- {日本|にほん}{有数|ゆうすう}の: one of Japan's top
- {国内|こくない}{有数|ゆうすう}の: one of the country's leading
- {有数|ゆうすう}の{企業|きぎょう}: a leading company

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {屈指|くっし}の: one of the best, top-ranking (similar meaning and pattern)
- {一流|いちりゅう}: first-rate, top-class
